Game Overview

Wolfoo Tangram is a jigsaw puzzle game built around quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Each session of Wolfoo Tangram follows a consistent rhythm. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Wolfoo Tangram?

Wolfoo Tangram is a free jigsaw puzzle game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Wolfoo Tangram free to play?

Yes, Wolfoo Tangram is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
